newsitem.title: USA: C.R. Bard sues Medtronic in patent dispute.
newsitem.headline: C.R. Bard sues Medtronic in patent dispute.

text.p: C.R. Bard Inc has alleged in a lawsuit that a Medtronic Inc product infringes on a Bard patent for arterial filters.
In papers filed in the U.S. District Court in Delaware, Bard seeks unspecified triple damages and an order prohibiting further alleged infringement by Medtronic.

Bard, based in Murray Hill, New Jersey, makes surgical, urological and cardiovascular medical devices. Medtronic, based in Minneapolis, is a major medical technology company specializing in implantable and invasive therapies.
A Medtronic spokesman was unavailable for comment.
